test_title: PYST 39 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose a word that is similar in meaning to the word in bold.

Farmers wash trees infested with insects with any one of the many insecticides not easily obtainable.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Accessible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"obtainable"** means something that can be acquired or gained. (प्राप्त करने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The information about the new policy is easily obtainable online.
 
 
• The word **"accessible"** refers to something that is easy to reach, enter, or use. It is often used to describe places, information, or resources that are available for use. (सुलभ)
 
 
• **Example: **The library is accessible to everyone in the community.
